 By Hadia Batool By Hadia Batool Hadia Batool is Web Editor of Minute Mirror. She can be reached at bhadia624@gmail.com. November 15, 2026 Share 2 Min Read SHARE Summary
 Kris Jenner is reportedly making repeated efforts to convince actor Jacob Elordi to appear on the family’s reality television series, The Kardashians, despite his alleged reluctance to become part of the famous family’s television empire.
 The insider claimed that Elordi remains polite towards Jenner but is uncomfortable with her repeated requests.
 The report further recalled claims that Kendall had previously threatened to leave the family reality series if her mother or other relatives discussed or referred to her relationship with Elordi on camera.
 AI Generated Summary Kris Jenner is reportedly making repeated efforts to convince actor Jacob Elordi to appear on the family’s reality television series, The Kardashians, despite his alleged reluctance to become part of the famous family’s television empire.
 According to a source quoted by In Touch, Jenner wants to build a closer relationship with her daughter Kendall Jenner’s boyfriend but has continued encouraging him to make an appearance on the show.
 However, Kendall has reportedly made it clear to her mother that Elordi has no interest in joining the programme or becoming associated with the Kardashian-Jenner brand.
 The insider claimed that Jenner has struggled to accept his decision and continues bringing up the possibility of featuring him in the series.
 The source also compared the situation with Jenner’s reported attempts to involve Kylie Jenner’s boyfriend, actor Timothée Chalamet, in the reality show.
 Jenner reportedly believes that featuring the family’s romantic relationships could generate interest in the programme. However, Chalamet has also allegedly remained reluctant to participate.

 The insider claimed that Elordi remains polite towards Jenner but is uncomfortable with her repeated requests.
 The report further recalled claims that Kendall had previously threatened to leave the family reality series if her mother or other relatives discussed or referred to her relationship with Elordi on camera.
 The 29-year-old actor, known for his roles in Euphoria and Wuthering Heights, has reportedly preferred to keep his personal life away from reality television.
 Neither Jenner nor Elordi has publicly addressed the claims.
